flawless: The woods grew around you as you fought. You simply did not notice.
Not a twig broken. The forest thanks you for so gentle a visit.
solid: You've trampled my ferns. They'll grow back, as will I.
The roots held, though you shook them. Peace, traveller.
close: I had to call on every root in Llanowar to stand up to you.
Oh, my poor heart. Fetch me some willow bark, would you?
